name: SaaS Dashboard
description: SaaS revenue metrics dashboard computed from raw MRR movements: MRR bridge waterfall (new, reactivation, expansion, contraction, churn), NRR and GRR, logo churn, CAC payback months, period switcher and a type-filterable movements ledger.

props.name: periods
props.description: { label, startingMrr, startingCustomers, salesMarketingSpend, grossMargin, movements[], mrrTrend[] } per period id

usage: mrrBridge(period) is exported and returns { by, net, ending, grr, nrr, churnedLogos, newLogos, logoChurn, payback }.
